name: Contact Person Role
definition: Person to be contacted in a given organisation. In the corporate action domain (including meeting notifications) , it is the contact person at the party organising the meeting, at the issuer or at an intermediary.

Role.name: Role
Role.definition: Role for which a contact person is specified.

Meeting.name: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Meeting for which a person is the contact.

Person.name: Person
Person.definition: Identifies the person which plays the role of contact.
